name: Brocade Silk Kurta
description: A festive maroon brocade silk kurta with a subtle woven pattern, mandarin collar, and comfortable straight fit. Ideal for weddings and Diwali celebrations.

name: Handloom Cotton Kurta
description: A breathable indigo handloom cotton kurta with block-print detailing. Lightweight and easy to wear for daytime events and casual festive gatherings.

name: Pastel Chikankari Kurta
description: An elegant ivory pastel kurta with delicate chikankari embroidery and a relaxed fit. A refined choice for summer celebrations, pujas, and daytime functions.

name: Classic Ivory Nehru Jacket
description: An ivory silk-blend Nehru jacket with a clean band collar and front buttons. Pairs well with kurtas for weddings, receptions, and formal festive looks.

name: Teal Printed Nehru Jacket
description: A teal art silk Nehru jacket featuring a geometric printed motif and a tailored silhouette. Adds color to a plain kurta for parties and family occasions.

name: Royal Blue Wedding Sherwani
description: A royal blue jacquard silk sherwani with antique gold embroidery and a structured fit. Designed for grooms and grand wedding ceremonies.

name: Ivory Embroidered Sherwani
description: A classic ivory raw silk sherwani with refined threadwork embroidery and matching buttons. A statement choice for wedding day and reception styling.

name: Mustard Bandhani Kurta Set
description: A mustard cotton-silk kurta set with Bandhani-inspired print and matching trousers. Bright, comfortable festive wear for Navratri and family celebrations.

name: Black Velvet Jodhpuri Suit
description: A sharp black velvet Jodhpuri suit with a satin lapel and fitted trousers. Suitable for evening receptions, cocktail events, and formal celebrations.

name: Peach Organza Dupatta
description: A lightweight peach organza dupatta with delicate zari edging. An easy way to elevate a plain kurta or Anarkali for festive occasions.

name: Wine Velvet Waistcoat
description: A rich wine velvet waistcoat with a textured finish and classic front buttons. Works over a kurta for winter weddings and evening celebrations.

name: Linen Blend Pathani Suit
description: A sand-colored linen-blend Pathani suit with a relaxed fit and practical side pockets. Comfortable traditional wear for Eid, family events, and daytime occasions.
